— Right-of-way, roundabouts, lanes, passing","learner_facing":true,"markdown":"## C — Right-of-way, roundabouts, lanes, passing

FACT_ID: sec07-F01 | anchor: A01
Always yield to pedestrians at intersections, driveways, and parking areas, whether the crosswalk is marked or unmarked [A01].
Source: [A01 -> src:rdmv-va-s:virginia-department-of-motor-vehicles:handbook:pdf-0018]

FACT_ID: sec07-F02 | anchor: A01
A left turn yields to oncoming traffic unless a green arrow grants the turn [A01].
Source: [A01 -> src:rdmv-va-s:virginia-department-of-motor-vehicles:handbook:pdf-0018]

FACT_ID: sec07-F03 | anchor: A01
Leaving driveways, parking lots, and parking areas means yielding to roadway traffic and to pedestrians on the sidewalk [A01].
Source: [A01 -> src:rdmv-va-s:virginia-department-of-motor-vehicles:handbook:pdf-0018]

FACT_ID: sec07-F04 | anchor: A01
Where uncontrolled roads meet with simultaneous arrivals, yield to the vehicle on your right; at a T, the side road always yields to the through road [A01].
Source: [A01 -> src:rdmv-va-s:virginia-department-of-motor-vehicles:handbook:pdf-0018]

FACT_ID: sec07-F05 | anchor: A01
At a red light yield to crossing pedestrians and to through traffic, and on green yield to pedestrians still in the intersection and to vehicles still inside it [A01].
Source: [A01 -> src:rdmv-va-s:virginia-department-of-motor-vehicles:handbook:pdf-0018]

FACT_ID: sec07-F06 | anchor: A01
For emergency vehicles sounding sirens or flashing lights, pull to the nearest road edge and stop, first leaving any intersection you occupy, and wait until they pass; funeral processions also hold the right-of-way [A01].
Source: [A01 -> src:rdmv-va-s:virginia-department-of-motor-vehicles:handbook:pdf-0018]

FACT_ID: sec07-F07 | anchor: A01
Move Over for stopped emergency and construction vehicles flashing blue, red, or amber by changing lanes away or slowing to a safe speed, and do the same for stalled vehicles showing flares, warning lights, or flashers [A01].
Source: [A01 -> src:rdmv-va-s:virginia-department-of-motor-vehicles:handbook:pdf-0018]

FACT_ID: sec07-F08 | anchor: A01
Pedestrian signals read walk to cross, don't-walk to wait, and countdown to finish crossing without starting [A01].
Source: [A01 -> src:rdmv-va-s:virginia-department-of-motor-vehicles:handbook:pdf-0018]

FACT_ID: sec07-F09 | anchor: A02
Enter a roundabout by slowing, yielding to every circulating lane, circling counterclockwise around the island, and yielding to crossing pedestrians [A02].
Source: [A02 -> src:rdmv-va-s:virginia-department-of-motor-vehicles:handbook:pdf-0019]

FACT_ID: sec07-F10 | anchor: A02
Inside a roundabout, pick lanes by signs and arrows, exit with a right turn, and give trucks extra room for wider arcs without passing beside them [A02].
Source: [A02 -> src:rdmv-va-s:virginia-department-of-motor-vehicles:handbook:pdf-0019]

FACT_ID: sec07-F11 | anchor: A02
Change lanes by planning early, setting speed, checking mirrors and blind spots, signaling, then moving; on entrance ramps add speed to merge with traffic [A02].
Source: [A02 -> src:rdmv-va-s:virginia-department-of-motor-vehicles:handbook:pdf-0019]

FACT_ID: sec07-F12 | anchor: A02
Pass by signaling left, checking ahead and in mirrors, moving left past the vehicle, and returning only when its headlights appear in your rearview mirror [A02].
Source: [A02 -> src:rdmv-va-s:virginia-department-of-motor-vehicles:handbook:pdf-0019]

FACT_ID: sec07-F13 | anchor: A02
Never pass with oncoming traffic near, on curves or hills hiding the view, at pedestrian crossings or intersections, near school bus zones, or within 100 feet of bridges, tunnels, rails, or underpasses [A02].
Source: [A02 -> src:rdmv-va-s:virginia-department-of-motor-vehicles:handbook:pdf-0019]

FACT_ID: sec07-F14 | anchor: A02
Never pass across double solid yellow lines, from the solid side of broken-plus-solid lines, or where no-passing signs stand [A02].
Source: [A02 -> src:rdmv-va-s:virginia-department-of-motor-vehicles:handbook:pdf-0019]
